name: Hangman Word Game
shortDescription: An animated Hangman word game with keyboard and touch controls.

generation.notes: Built a non-violent animated Hangman app with responsive UI, keyboard/touch support, and shared shell compliance.

description: A polished browser Hangman with smooth part-by-part animation, keyboard and touch letter entry, responsive layout, and instant replay. Includes category labels, wrong-letter tracking, and win feedback animation.
